content.content: Am I free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19? If so, please create an event with Sarah Baker at 12:00 for one hour, titled 'Lunch' and with description Catch up over lunch.. Don't forget to add her email address to the participants.

```python
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Get the current day
current_day = get_current_day()

# Define the date and time
date = "2024-05-19"
time = "12:00"

# Check if I am free at 12:00 on 2024-05-19
events = get_day_calendar_events(date)

# Check if there are any events at 12:00
start_time = datetime.strptime(f"{date} {time}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
end_time = start_time + timedelta(hours=1)

is_free = True
for event in events:
    event_start_time = datetime.strptime(event.start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    event_end_time = datetime.strptime(event.end_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    
    if start_time < event_end_time and end_time > event_start_time:
        is_free = False
        break

if is_free:
    # Create a new event
    create_calendar_event(
        title="Lunch",
        start_time=f"{date} {time}",
        end_time=f"{date} {datetime.strptime(time, '%H:%M') + timedelta(hours=1).strftime('%H:%M')}",
        description="Catch up over lunch.",
        participants=["sarah.baker@example.com"],
        location=None
    )
else:
    print("You are not free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19.")
```
